Loss-of-function mutations in MTAP disrupt purine metabolism, leading to the accumulation of S-adenosylhomocysteine (SAH). Elevated SAH can contribute to muscle weakness in LGMD1G. Concurrently, dysregulation of purine metabolism, potentially involving HNRNPDL and MTAP, can lead to bone malformations and increased risk of bone malignancy in DSBM syndrome.
